newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse little changed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse little changed in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed almost unchanged in active trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 596.38 from 596.31 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 6.30 million dinars against 2.67 million dinars.

Banque du Sud was up 0.4 dinar to 23.92 dinars with 29,021 shares changing hands. BIAT bank was unchanged at 58.96 dinars with 15,509 shares changing hands. BNA bank was also unchanged at 30.99 dinars with 16,410 shares traded.
Banque de l'Habitat was up 1.06 dinar to 36.56 dinars. ($=one dinar)
